remarks: This spacious Colonial, set on two acres in New Canaan's sought-after Hoyt Farm community, offers a classic layout and has been completely updated. The home features a soaring cathedral-ceiling family room with fireplace, formal living and dining rooms with backyard views, and a cozy den or office. A brand-new kitchen includes high-end appliances, an island, and access to decks from the sunny breakfast room. Upstairs are three generous bedrooms and a large primary suite with walk-in closet, plus an additional bedroom on the finished third floor. All three and a half bathrooms have been beautifully renovated with a clean, modern aesthetic. Brand new systems too! This is the one you've been waiting for.
